taskDescription: Complete the crossword using key terms from PA H2 | Approach to Anemia & Lab Investigation.

words.clue: The oxygen-carrying iron-containing protein in red blood cells whose reduction defines anemia by WHO criteria.
The percentage of blood volume occupied by red blood cells, also known as PCV.
Mean corpuscular volume; the measurement that determines if anemia is microcytic, normocytic, or macrocytic.
A young immature red blood cell containing residual ribosomes that appears larger than mature RBCs.
The process of red blood cell destruction that occurs faster than production in hemolytic anemias.
Inherited genetic disorder of hemoglobin synthesis that causes severe microcytic hemolytic anemia.
Water-soluble B vitamin whose deficiency causes megaloblastic macrocytic anemia with hypersegmented neutrophils.
Type of bone marrow failure where normal hematopoietic tissue is replaced by fat tissue.
Reduction in total circulating red blood cell mass defined operationally by hemoglobin below WHO thresholds.
Red cell distribution width; this parameter is elevated when there is a mixed population of RBC sizes.
